from.place: Proof paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction and coherent tower realization, through the pointed-model stability foundation and the finite pushout grid in lem-coef-suspension-square-comparison: the underlying fiber-cone assembly used to construct a finite-poset extension, before proving its unit or its Kan universal property. Local relative extension over one positive-dimensional simplex, with the boundary already fixed, in the skeletal assembly proof. Prerequisite: Fiberwise relative initiality fills a boundary in a cartesian family. Mapping-space comparison over a single base edge, used before the whole-boundary filler.

title: Mapping fibers determined by a cartesian edge
statement:
Use quasicategories, right-pinched mapping spaces, homotopy fibers and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], postcomposition of mapping spaces by an edge as in [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition], and inner fibrations and horn-cartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $p:E\to B$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories in a fixed universe, let $e:y\to z$ be a $p$-cartesian edge, and put $s=p(y)$, $t=p(z)$ and $f=p(e)$. Write $E_s=E\times_B\{s\}$ for the degreewise fiber. For every $w\in E_s$, coherent postcomposition with $e$ induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{E_s}(w,y)\simeq\operatorname{hofib}_{f}\bigl(\operatorname{Map}_E(w,z)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_B(s,t)\bigr).$$
The mapping spaces in this formula are Kan complexes. The equivalence is natural under functors over $B$ which carry the specified cartesian edge to a cartesian edge: if $p':E'\to B$ is another inner fibration and $T:E\to E'$ satisfies $p'T=p$ and $T(e)$ is $p'$-cartesian, then the square between these equivalences for $(w,e)$ and $(T(w),T(e))$ commutes up to homotopy; its left map is the map induced by $T_s:E_s\to E'_s$ and its right map is the induced map of homotopy fibers. No existence of cartesian lifts other than the specified edge is required.

source.place: Kerodon Proposition 5.1.3.11 (01U8), restricted to cartesian edges, with Proposition 4.6.1.22 for mapping Kan fibrations, Proposition 3.4.0.7 for homotopy fibers, and Proposition 4.6.5.10 for the natural right-pinched comparison. Naturality is that of postcomposition. Read online 2026-10-17; not archived. Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag.
